orphan.description: Present and true only on a worktree no agent records: one an agent left behind when it was retired, renamed or moved. Its owner is null. Never the repo's own checkout or a locked worktree.

merged.description: Orphans only: whether its HEAD is merged into main.

files_changed.description: Orphans only: its changed and untracked files, as git status counts them.

commits_ahead.description: Orphans only: its commits not on main.

size_bytes.description: Orphans only: the bytes it takes on disk, as housekeeping last measured them (at most hourly, off the daemon's tick); null until measured.

methods.name: worktrees.list
methods.summary: Worktrees with status and changed files.
methods.description: The worktrees agents work in, then the orphans: worktrees of the same repos that no agent records (orphan true), each with what it holds that main does not and its size. `owner` lists no orphans, since they have none; `repo` narrows both, by the repo's name or path.

methods.name: worktree.diff
methods.summary: Read-only git diff run by the daemon. Without `file`: the changes to tracked files against HEAD, then a new-file diff of each untracked file that .gitignore does not ignore (at most 200; one too big for what is left of the size cap is listed as `(new file, N bytes: not shown)`, not diffed). With `file`: that file alone, untracked or not.

methods.name: worktree.remove
methods.summary: Remove an orphan worktree (worktrees.list orphan), the founder's choice from the list.

schema.description: The orphan's path, as worktrees.list gives it.
Remove it even though it holds work: files changed, or commits not on main. The person's confirm; nothing asks again.

branch_deleted.description: Whether its branch went too: only for one merged into main and clean, by `git branch -d`. A forced removal leaves the branch.

methods.description: A worktree merged into main with nothing changed goes at once, with its branch. One that holds work is refused, gate `dirty`, with `files_changed` and `commits_ahead` in the error data, unless force. A path that is no orphan (an agent works in it, or it is not a worktree of an agent's repo) is refused, gate `orphan`: an agent's worktree goes only with the agent. If git cannot remove it, the call is refused, gate `git`, with git's words.

methods.name: file.read
methods.summary: The founder reads a text file in an agent's worktree.

schema.description: Relative to the agent's worktree, with `/` between parts. No .., no empty or . part, not absolute, no backslash, and no part of it (nor the worktree path under it) may be a symlink: bad_request (field path) otherwise.

text.description: UTF-8 text; the first 1 MiB when the file is longer (truncated).

truncated.description: The file is over 1 MiB and text is its first 1 MiB. Do not write it back.

etag.description: SHA-256 of the whole file, hex: file.write takes it back.

methods.name: file.write
methods.summary: The founder replaces or creates a .md or .json file in an agent's worktree, if it is still what the etag says.

schema.description: Relative to the agent's worktree, with `/` between parts. No .., no empty or . part, not absolute, no backslash, and no part of it (nor the worktree path under it) may be a symlink: bad_request (field path) otherwise.
The whole new content: UTF-8 text without NUL, at most 1 MiB; for a .json file, valid JSON.
The etag file.read gave; empty to create a file that must not exist (its folder must).

methods.name: worktree.set_status
methods.summary: Set the status label of a worktree. The status is a free string (Worktree.status), 1 to 40 characters; the label changes nothing on disk, and worktrees.list shows it in place of the daemon's own word (dirty or clean). A path that is not a worktree an agent works in is not_found, what worktree, as for worktree.diff.
